g.text: Teensy 4.0 pin numbers on this symbol are physical positions counted from the USB end (1-14 left row, 15-28 right row).

g.desc: Teensy 4.0 pin numbers on this symbol are physical positions counted from the USB end (1-14 left row, 15-28 right row).

g.text: USB micro-B on the Teensy is the only connector: class-compliant MIDI in, 5 V in. Leave the VUSB-VIN pad on the underside intact so VIN exports the bus 5 V.

g.desc: USB micro-B on the Teensy is the only connector: class-compliant MIDI in, 5 V in. Leave the VUSB-VIN pad on the underside intact so VIN exports the bus 5 V.

g.text: SPI0: pin 13 SCK, pin 11 MOSI, pin 10 CS. MISO (12) unused - PGA SDO is 5 V logic and must not come back. DIP switch closed = 0, internal pull-ups on.

g.desc: SPI0: pin 13 SCK, pin 11 MOSI, pin 10 CS. MISO (12) unused - PGA SDO is 5 V logic and must not come back. DIP switch closed = 0, internal pull-ups on.

g.text: Set the CPU clock to 150 MHz in firmware; it halves the Teensy current.

g.desc: Set the CPU clock to 150 MHz in firmware; it halves the Teensy current.

g.text: R15 holds both PGA2310s muted until the firmware writes its first gains: no power-on thump.

g.desc: R15 holds both PGA2310s muted until the firmware writes its first gains: no power-on thump.

g.text: MIDI activity LED on Teensy pin 8, about 2 mA.

g.desc: MIDI activity LED on Teensy pin 8, about 2 mA.
